findings.body: Done-when item 10 requires a live July-warehouse/Bedrock walk, with each question in a fresh conversation, recorded in the last commit. The supplied evidence explicitly says the last commit has no `Functional check:` paragraph, and this task record contains only its start event. There is therefore no evidence that all 21 names appeared, 50001201 footed to ₹83,98,339, the DUB-only result matched the statement drill, or the statement panel showed the three columns.
